page.sound_on: Sound when an alert starts and ends
page.sound_note: Applies at once, without a restart. The play buttons also save the volume and the sounds. Home Assistant also has the sound and the volume. Eco mode has no sound: nobody is at home. The speaker goes to the SPK connector.
page.own_sounds_table: Own sounds need a new partition table: flash the device through USB once.
page.own_sounds_note: A WAV file without compression (PCM), 8 or 16 bit, mono or stereo, 8000–48000 Hz; up to %u s at 16000 Hz, up to %u s at 44100 Hz. To play a file, select «Own file» for the event.
page.eco_note: Between the updates Wi-Fi is off, and the screen shows the last data. KEY changes the screens; BOOT updates the data now and keeps Wi-Fi on for 2 minutes to open this page. While the page is open, the device does not sleep. Home Assistant also has the switch.
page.meteo_note: The forecast for tomorrow for a regional centre, once an hour. Applies at once; Home Assistant also has the city.
page.tls_make_csr: Make a key and a request (CSR)
page.tls_csr_note: The key stays on the device. Sign the request (the file %s.csr) with your certificate authority and install the certificate.
page.tls_or_title: Or a key and a certificate from a computer
page.tls_issue_note: For a device without a request: make a key and a certificate for the name %s with your certificate authority. After the install, delete the key on the computer.
page.tls_install_both: Install the key and the certificate
page.tls_note: Through the access point the page always opens with HTTP. Install the root certificate of your authority (ca.crt) on phones and computers once.
page.offline_reopen: The page opens again when the device answers.
page.screen_note: KEY on the device also changes the screens in a circle; «Note» only when it has a text. «Clock» is the offline mode: Wi-Fi, MQTT and the HA data are off, the device sleeps and updates the time each minute; then the page does not open, KEY goes back.
page.note_placeholder: for example: Water in the jars on the balcony. The keys are at the neighbour's.
page.note_hint: A new line with Enter. The font size is automatic: a shorter text gets larger letters.
page.entities_note: Entities: the main one first, then the backups, separated by commas.
page.hc_key: healthchecks.io: read-only API key (Project Settings → API Access)
page.ping_host: Device without backup power (IP or name) to ping
page.dtek_note: The grid state comes from the first source that knows it: the HA entity (above), the healthchecks.io check («up» — power, «grace» and «down» — no power), the ping of a device without backup power. The ping only when the first two tell nothing; no answer — no grid power. UPS input power without grid power — generator; UPS on battery or no answer — no power.
page.server_note: While the screen is «From server», Wi-Fi and MQTT are off. Every 5 min the device turns them on: it sends the room temperature, humidity and battery, gets the commands and this image, and turns them off again. The page opens at that time, 2 min after BOOT and while somebody uses it. The device draws the date, the time and the battery in the top left quadrant itself each minute. If trmnl-server does not answer, the device takes the data from Home Assistant and draws the quadrants itself; without a connection it shows the last image with its time. This screen has no alert sound.
page.host: Device name in the network (for the router and HTTPS)
page.web_pass_note: Without a password anybody in the home network can open the page. Through the access point of the device the password is never necessary.
page.ota_note: The archive build\rlcd-dashboard-<version>.tar from the project folder: the firmware and manifest.json with the version and SHA-256. The device checks the archive, writes the firmware to the other partition and restarts. If the new version does not work in one and a half minutes, the device goes back to the previous one.
page.footer:
Version %s. Access point: %s, password %s, http://%s.
BOOT 3 s — access point on, BOOT 10 s — reset the settings.
msg.bad_dns: DNS must be an IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.1.
msg.bad_mqtt: The broker address must start with mqtt:// or mqtts://.
msg.bad_ha: The Home Assistant address must start with http:// or https://.
msg.bad_host: Device name: Latin letters, digits, hyphens and dots, for example rlcd.lan.
msg.saved: Saved. The device restarts and connects with the new settings.
msg.ota_bad_size: The file size is not correct for a firmware archive.
msg.ota_done: Done: version %s is in partition %s. The device restarts.
msg.url_bad_length: The address is empty or too long.
msg.url_bad_scheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
msg.other_project: This is the firmware of another project: %s.
msg.no_update: No update: the server has the same build, %s.
msg.newer: The server has a newer version: %s. Now: %s. Update?
msg.older: The server has an older version: %s. Now: %s. Install it?
msg.same_version: The server has another build of the same version: %s. Now: %s. Update?
msg.bad_file_size: The file size is not correct.
msg.sound_saved: Saved: %u.%u s. To play the file, select «Own file» for the event.
msg.sound_delete_failed: Cannot delete the file: try again.
msg.csr_failed: Cannot make the key and the request.
msg.cert_bad_size: The file size is not correct for a certificate.
msg.cert_deleted: The certificate is deleted. The device restarts; then the page opens with HTTP.
js.warn_server: «From server» is the semi-offline mode: Wi-Fi is on every 5 min for some seconds, between the sessions the page does not open. Change the mode with the buttons on the device: KEY — next screen, BOOT — Wi-Fi for 2 min. Change?
js.warn_clock: «Clock» is the offline mode: Wi-Fi goes off, and the page does not open. Change the mode with the buttons on the device: KEY — next screen. Change?
js.state_clock: The device seems to be offline («Clock»). Change the mode with the buttons on the device: KEY — next screen.
js.state_server: The device seems to be offline («From server»: a connection every 5 min). Change the mode with the buttons on the device: KEY — next screen, BOOT — Wi-Fi for 2 min.
js.state_eco: The device seems to be in eco mode: Wi-Fi is on only for the updates. BOOT on the device turns Wi-Fi on for 2 min.
js.state_none: The device does not answer. Maybe it is offline: change the mode with the buttons on the device (KEY — next screen). Or check the power and Wi-Fi.
js.need_url: Type the address of the archive.
js.tls_delete_confirm: Delete the certificate? The page will open only with HTTP again.
fw.bin_file: This is a .bin file; a firmware archive .tar (with manifest.json) is necessary.
fw.not_tar: This is not a firmware archive (.tar).
fw.bad_header: The archive is damaged: file header.
fw.bad_checksum: The archive is damaged: header checksum.
fw.bad_size: The archive is damaged: file size.
fw.two_manifests: The archive has two manifest.json files.
fw.size_mismatch: The size of %s (%u bytes) is not the size in the manifest (%u bytes).
fw.manifest_first: In the archive manifest.json must come before the firmware file.
fw.manifest_fields: manifest.json does not have the necessary fields.
fw.too_big: The firmware (%.0f bytes) is larger than partition %s (%u bytes).
fw.too_small: The firmware file is too small.
fw.not_esp32: %s in the archive is not an ESP32 firmware.
fw.other_target: Firmware for another chip, not for %s.
fw.not_app: %s in the archive is not an application (maybe a bootloader).
fw.other_project_file: The firmware file of another project.
fw.version_mismatch: The version in the firmware file (%s) is not the version in the manifest (%s).
fw.sha_mismatch: The SHA-256 of the firmware is not the one in the manifest: the file is damaged or changed.
fw.cut: The archive is cut: the firmware file is not complete.
fw.not_signed: The image check failed: the firmware is not signed with your key, or it is damaged.
fw.boot_failed: Cannot select the new firmware for the start: %s.
fw.link_lost: The connection to the server is lost.
fw.no_archive: The server did not give the archive.
fw.url_not_tar: The address does not give a firmware archive (.tar).
fw.manifest_not_first: manifest.json must be the first file in the archive.
fw.no_manifest_answer: The server did not give manifest.json.
snd.no_partition: No partition for sounds: flash the new partition table through USB once.
snd.busy: A sound plays or another upload runs. Try again.
snd.need_pcm: A WAV file without compression (PCM) is necessary. Convert the file, for example, in Audacity.
snd.channels: Mono or stereo sound is necessary, the file has %u channels.
snd.bits: 8-bit or 16-bit sound is necessary, the file has %u bits.
snd.too_long: The file is too long: at %u Hz up to %u s fits.
snd.not_wav: This is not a WAV file.
snd.no_format: The WAV file has no format description before the sound.
snd.ended_early: The file ends before the sound starts.
snd.cut: The file is cut: less sound than the header tells.
snd.rate: The rate %u Hz is not supported. Use one of: 8000, 11025, 16000, 22050, 32000, 44100, 48000 Hz.
cert.no_cert: The file has no certificate (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----).
cert.not_pair: The key and the certificate are not a pair (or cannot read the key).
cert.new_key_waits: ; a new key waits for its certificate
cert.none: no certificate — the page opens with HTTP%s
cert.other_key: The certificate is not for the key of this device. Make a request (CSR) and sign that request, or upload the key together with the certificate.
cert.installed: The certificate is installed, valid until %02d.%02d.%04d.%s The device restarts; then the page opens with https://%s.
cert.no_name: Note: the certificate does not have the device name — the browser will warn.
data.bad_token: HA: the token is not correct (HTTP 401)
data.not_configured: HA is not set: no address or token
status.fw_rollback: Firmware: partition %s, rollback after a failed update is on
status.fw_no_rollback: Firmware: partition %s, rollback is off (the build has no BOOTLOADER_APP_ROLLBACK_ENABLE)
status.signed: Update: only firmware signed with your key
status.eco_on: Eco mode: on, update every %d min
status.battery_charging: Battery: %.2f V, charging, about %d %% (the voltage on charge is higher than the battery voltage)
status.battery_usb: Battery: %.2f V, USB power (the charge is not known during charging)
status.tz_firmware: Time zone: firmware rules (%s), nothing from Home Assistant yet
status.low_battery: Low battery: «Clock» until USB power, then «%s»
status.ha_data_error: Home Assistant: data at %02d:%02d, last try — %s
page.alerts_note: When the alert entity fields (Home Assistant above) are empty, the device takes the alerts of the region from ubilling.net.ua once a minute: red level — missile alert, yellow — drone alert. Applies at once; Home Assistant also has the region.
wizard.title: First setup
wizard.intro: Answer some questions. Change the rest later on the full settings page.
wizard.ha_note: Without Home Assistant the «Dashboard» and «4 quadrants» screens are not available: the weather, the air and the power come from it. The alerts then come from ubilling.net.ua for the region.
wizard.srv_note: Without trmnl-server the «From server» screen is not available.
page.has_ha: I have Home Assistant (without it «Dashboard» and «4 quadrants» are not available)
page.has_srv: I have trmnl-server (without it «From server» is not available)
